reply: 杠杆平衡看的是“力矩”而不是“重量”：左端力矩 = 左力 × 左力臂，右端力矩 = 右力 × 右力臂，两边相等时杠杆就水平。力臂是从支点到力的作用线的垂直距离；力不变而力臂变长，力矩就变大，所以小力配长臂也能平衡大力。进入小游戏后，拖动左右两个砝码改变力臂：先看两边力矩数字的差距，再小步移动砝码，直到两边相等。你已经调到的位置我无法凭空判断，请在游戏里实际试出来。

blocks.title: 调平杠杆：找到力矩相等的位置
blocks.goal: 通过拖动砝码改变左右力臂，让左力×左力臂与右力×右力臂相等，理解杠杆平衡条件。
blocks.instructions: 拖动橙色和蓝色砝码，把两边力矩调到相等。
blocks.code: const L={f:4,min:1,max:4,step:0.5,x:32},R={f:2,min:1,max:4,step:0.5,x:55};let drag=null,glow=0,moves=0,over=false;const PIV=50;function mx(a,side){return side==='L'?PIV-a.x*14:a.x*14-PIV;}function ok(){return Math.abs(L.f*mx(L,'L')-R.f*mx(R,'R'))<0.01;}function snap(v){return Math.max(1,Math.min(4,Math.round(v*2)/2));}function draw(){const cmds=[['rect',0,0,100,100,'#f7f3ea'],['rect',0,0,100,14,'#e9dfcd'],['text','调平杠杆',50,7,4.5,'#7a5c2e','center','bold'],['rect',0,86,100,14,'#efe6d5'],['text','左力矩 '+ (L.f*mx(L,'L')).toFixed(1),24,90,3.6,'#c26a1e','center','bold'],['text','右力矩 '+ (R.f*mx(R,'R')).toFixed(1),76,90,3.6,'#276B91','center','bold']];cmds.push(['line',12,70,88,70,'#c9b79b',1.2]);cmds.push(['poly',[46.5,63,53.5,63,50,70],'#7a5c2e',1]);cmds.push(['circle',PIV,70,2.2,'#7a5c2e']);const same=ok();cmds.push(['line',PIV,70,PIV,50,'#bfae94',0.8]);cmds.push(['text',same?'平衡':'不平衡',50,40,4.5,same?'#2f8f6b':'#b07a8a','center','bold']);if(!same){const d=Math.abs(L.f*mx(L,'L')-R.f*mx(R,'R')).toFixed(1);cmds.push(['text','差距 '+d,50,48,3.4,'#9a8a72','center']);}cmds.push(['rect',PIV-L.x*14-4,63,8,11,'#c26a1e',2,0]);cmds.push(['rect',PIV+L.x*14.0,0,0,0,'#00000000',0]);cmds.push(['rect',PIV+L.x*14-4,63,8,11,'#276B91',2,0]);cmds.push(['text',String(L.f),PIV-L.x*14,67.5,3.5,'#ffffff','center','bold']);cmds.push(['text',String(R.f),PIV+R.x*14,67.5,3.5,'#ffffff','center','bold']);cmds.push(['line',PIV,70,PIV,55,'#e4d9c4',1]);cmds.push(['line',PIV,70,PIV,55,'#d3c4a8',0.8]);cmds.push(['line',PIV,70,PIV,55,'#a89a83',0.6]);cmds.push(['line',PIV,70,PIV,55,'#8a7c66',0.5]);cmds.push(['line',PIV,70,PIV,55,'#6b5c46',0.4]);cmds.push(['line',PIV,70,PIV,55,'#4a3d2a',0.3]);cmds.push(['line',PIV,70,PIV-L.x*14,55,'#efe2cc',1]);cmds.push(['line',PIV,70,PIV+L.x*14,55,'#efe2cc',1]);cmds.push(['line',PIV,70,PIV-L.x*14,55,'#ead9bd',1]);cmds.push(['line',PIV,70,PIV-L.x*14,63,'#e3cfa8',0.6]);cmds.push(['line',PIV,70,PIV+L.x*14,63,'#e3cfa8',0.6]);cmds.push(['rect',PIV-L.x*14-2,55,4,15,'#f0b27a',1]);cmds.push(['rect',PIV+L.x*14-2,55,4,15,'#a8c8e0',1]);cmds.push(['text','拖我',PIV-L.x*14,52,3,'#a05a1a','center']);cmds.push(['text','拖我',PIV+L.x*14,52,3,'#276B91','center']);cmds.push(['text','支点',PIV,74,3,'#7a5c2e','center']);cmds.push(['text','左臂 '+mx(L,'L').toFixed(1)+'m',PIV-L.x*14,80,2.8,'#9a8a72','center']);cmds.push(['text','右臂 '+mx(R,'R').toFixed(1)+'m',PIV+R.x*14,80,2.8,'#9a8a72','center']);cmds.push(['text','拖动砝码改变力臂',50,31,3.2,'#8a7c66','center']);cmds.push(['text','4N',PIV-L.x*14,59,2.6,'#a05a1a','center']);cmds.push(['text','2N',PIV+R.x*14,59,2.6,'#276B91','center']);if(glow>0){cmds.push(['circle',PIV-L.x*14,69,5,'#f0b27a']);cmds.push(['circle',PIV+R.x*14,69,5,'#a8c8e0']);}game.draw(cmds);}game.onPointer(p=>{if(over)return;if(p.phase==='down'){const dl=Math.abs(p.x-(PIV-L.x*14)),dr=Math.abs(p.x-(PIV+R.x*14));if(dl<6&&p.y>50&&p.y<80)drag='L';else if(dr<6&&p.y>50&&p.y<80)drag='R';}else if(p.phase==='move'&&drag){const v=snap(Math.abs(p.x-PIV)/14);if(drag==='L')L.x=Math.max(1,Math.min(4,v));else R.x=Math.max(1,Math.min(4,v));draw();}else if(p.phase==='up'){if(drag){moves++;drag=null;if(ok()){over=true;glow=2;draw();game.say('左右力矩相等，杠杆平衡。');game.finish('杠杆平衡条件：左力×左力臂 = 右力×右力臂。4N×1m = 2N×2m = 4N·m。');}else{draw();game.say('还没平衡，看看两边力矩差多少。');}}}});game.buttons([{id:'reset',label:'重来'}]);game.onAction(id=>{if(id==='reset'){L.x=1;R.x=1;drag=null;glow=0;moves=0;over=false;draw();game.say('已重置，再试一次。');}});game.say('拖动橙色和蓝色砝码，让两边力矩相等。');draw();
